name: single-cell-qc-preprocessing
description: Process raw single-cell count matrices through quality control, doublet removal, and normalization. Filter cells by minimum gene count (200-500 genes), maximum mitochondrial percentage (species-dependent: 5-20%), and minimum UMI count. Detect doublets with Scrublet (simulates doublets by averaging random cell pairs and scores each cell by nearest-neighbor overlap with simulated doublets).
